title: enigma-python-mcp belongs on your radar
description:
denismaggior8/enigma-python-mcp is the kind of repo that can quietly upgrade a developer workflow. An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that brings the capabilities of the enigmapython library to LLMs, allowing them to encrypt and decrypt messages using historically accurate Enigma machine emulators. It has about 4 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/denismaggior8/enigma-python-mcp

#GitHub #OpenSource #Developer #Programming #Shorts
